seo_title: Cost of Living in Hanoi 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Hanoi per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: The capital of Vietnam with a thousand-year history: 45 days visa-free, very low prices and a buzzing street life. Cooler than the south in winter; the downsides are heavy traffic, noise and air quality.
pros: Very low prices and delicious street food
A rich history and vibrant city life
A growing scene for remote workers and coffee shops
Cooler and more comfortable than the south in winter
cons: Noise and air quality in the centre
A language barrier outside tourist spots

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Up to 45 days without a visa for Russian citizens — the stamp is issued at the border.

visa_steps.title: E-visa (for long stays)
visa_steps.description: A 90-day e-visa is issued online on the official portal.

visa_steps.title: Renting a home
visa_steps.description: Apartments and flats rent monthly; the districts around West Lake are popular.

visa_steps.title: Bank account and connectivity
visa_steps.description: A local SIM card is cheap; you'll need cash dong and a foreign bank card.

visa_steps.title: Long-term stay
visa_steps.description: To live beyond the visa, you'll need a TRC through employment or business.

faq.question: Do Russians need a visa for Hanoi?
faq.answer: Up to 45 days you don't need a visa. For a longer stay you apply for a 90-day e-visa.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Hanoi?
faq.answer: Very cheap, especially food and transport. See the exact budget in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Hanoi?
faq.answer: Vietnamese; English is understood in tourist spots, but there can be a language barrier in daily life.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Hanoi?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You'll need cash dong and a foreign bank card.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Hanoi?
faq.answer: Subtropical: hot, humid summers and noticeably cooler winters than the south.

faq.question: How does Hanoi differ from Ho Chi Minh City?
faq.answer: Hanoi is older, more laid-back and cooler in winter; Ho Chi Minh City is more business-minded and hot year-round.

reviews.text: Hanoi is cheap and full of character — the coffee and food are a love of their own. The sea of bikes takes getting used to, and the air in the centre is so-so.
I chose Hanoi for the atmosphere and the prices. It's pleasantly cool in winter. The downside is the language barrier outside the centre and the noise of a big city.
